thread:
Carlos Mendez: Observed a cluster of mTLS handshake aborts between apac-west -> eu-west after the keystore-operator RBAC tighten this morning. Impacting model-sync and telemetry-ingest.
Olivia Park: Any sample errors? Which clusters?
Carlos Mendez: proxy-apac-1 and proxy-eu-canary. Example from proxy log: `2025-01-12T02:14:05Z proxy-apac-1 conn=98765 tls: handshake_failed reason=cert_chain_incomplete; detail=missing_intermediate; local_cert=rewrap-pending`
Rina Kapoor: KMS audit shows repeated PermissionDenied (403) for keystore-operator service account when trying to unwrap cert keys in apac. KMS-bot flagged HSM queue warnings as well.
KMS-bot: Alert: 403 unwrap errors x6 in last 7m for key alias projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/cert-wrap; non-retryable=false
Olivia Park: Sounds like the RBAC patch scoped cryptoKeyVersions too narrowly and excluded the version used for rewrap. That would cause rewrap to fail and partial chain issuance.
Carlos Mendez: Short-term mitigations I'm doing now: 1) revert RBAC delta in apac-canary 2) enable proxy cached full-chain preference until rewrap completes 3) bump cert-provisioner audit retention to 7d for investigation.
Olivia Park: Run these quick checks after rollback: 
- openssl s_client -connect proxy-apac-1:443 -showcerts -servername service-host
- kubectl -n infra logs deploy/cert-provisioner | grep unwrap
- gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/cert-wrap
KMS-bot: Recommend also: gcloud logging read "protoPayload.status.code=7 AND resource.labels.location=apac" --limit 50
Rina Kapoor: Long-term: add CI gate that simulates RBAC changes against a mock KMS to ensure we don't exclude key versions. Also add an integration test that simulates HSM queuing/unwrap delays and verifies proxies keep TLS1.3 and full chain until rewrap success.
Carlos Mendez: Also proposing rollout playbook: dry-run in staging -> IAM allowed-list check -> apac-canary with 100% TLS chain sampling for 20m -> verify unwraps success before global.
Olivia Park: Telemetry follow-ups: expose `tls_chain_complete:boolean` and `kms_unwrap_ms:int` from proxies; sample 100% in canaries for 15m then 5% global. Alert if chain_incomplete rate >3x baseline for 5m.
Rina Kapoor: Vulnerability triage note: over-permissive RBAC can be privilege escalation; over-restricting causes availability and potential partial-chain MITM risk. Add both to weekly vuln review.
secops-bot: Incident INC-20250112-1001 created: "inter-region mTLS failures during keystore-operator RBAC tighten" (owner: Olivia Park).
Carlos Mendez: Rollback complete in canary, 403s dropped to 0. Leaving 100% TLS chain sampling on for 15m and moving incident to monitoring. I'll draft an RCA for #postmortems with timeline and follow-ups.
Olivia Park: Thanks everyone. I'll add runbook commands to the ticket and schedule the CI gate work.
KMS-bot: Incident INC-20250112-1001 status updated: investigating -> monitoring
